market_rationale: The rate increase and higher inflation projections justify some repricing, but resilient demand and strong capital investment argue against treating every cyclical pullback as fundamental deterioration. Cross-sectional return spreads are large, although the aggregate dispersion statistic is missing. Favor selective reversals rather than broad dip-buying or extrapolation of oil and crypto strength; confidence over the one-month window is modest.
portfolio_rationale: The leading reversals pair relative pullbacks with independent support from capital investment or resilient domestic demand. Semiconductors offer the greatest upside but also the widest uncertainty; industrials and small value have more contained risk. Quality scores are price-derived composites, not balance-sheet evidence. Other losers lack sufficient support, while recent speculative winners lack convincing continuation catalysts.
